description: This file contains a low-level implementation of a printf-like function (`lp_Print`) used for formatted output, along with helper functions for printing characters, strings, and numbers with various formatting options. It is part of an LZMA loader component within a Linux kernel or embedded system environment.

methods.name: void lp_Print(void (* output)(void *,char *,int),void * arg,char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: A low-level formatted print function that processes format strings and variable arguments to produce output via a callback function.

methods.name: int PrintChar(char * buf,char c,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Helper function to print a single character with padding and justification.

methods.name: int PrintString(char * buf,char * s,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Helper function to print a string with specified width and justification.

methods.name: int PrintNum(char * buf,unsigned long u,int base,int negFlag,int length,int ladjust,char padc,int upcase)
methods.description: Helper function to convert and format a number into a string with support for various bases, padding, and sign handling.
